name: @mercury/core
comment:versions: Pinned to the exact versions the pre-monorepo repo had installed, not carets — re-resolving them turned an earlier move into an upgrade (^1.18.0 pulled @qdrant/js-client-rest 1.19.0, which dropped QdrantClient.search and broke the typecheck). Upgrading is a separate decision with its own testing.
comment:test-only-plugins: The first-party plugins below are TEST-only devDependencies: the plugin-coupled test suites that moved here with the runtime (the jira oracle, cli-config-loader.*, plugin-loader, system-prompt, cli-binary) import them. The core's RUNTIME deps stay plugin-agnostic. These devDeps are removed when #26 relocates those tests into their plugin packages.
